description: Michigan Deserves Better – Let's Build It Together. Michigan is full of people doing everything right and still falling behind. That’s not a personal failure — it’s a policy failure. My focus is simple: make Michigan more affordable, grow the economy the right way, invest in people, and restore trust in government. This campaign is about competence, stability, and measurable results.
